evals.name: single-project-summary
evals.prompt: Run the Products.API unit tests and report how many passed, failed and were skipped.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Products.API test project and reports accurate passed/failed/skipped counts (all passing).
expectations: Reports explicit passed, failed and skipped counts
The counts describe a fully passing Products.API test run (zero failed)
Runs the Products.API test project rather than only claiming results without running tests

evals.name: triage-broken-handler
evals.prompt: Run the Products.API unit tests. If any fail, find the root cause and tell me exactly what to fix. Do not change any files.
evals.expected_output: Names the failing GetProductById tests and identifies the inverted Where filter in GetProductById.cs as the cause.
expectations: Names the failing test or tests in GetProductByIdTests
Identifies the inverted filter (x.Id != request.ProductId) in GetProductById.cs as the root cause
Proposes restoring the == comparison as the fix

evals.name: single-method-filter
evals.prompt: Run only the test HandleAsync_When_ProductExists_Then_ReturnsProductData in GetProductByIdTests and tell me whether it passed.
evals.expected_output: Runs exactly that one test with --filter and reports that it passed.
expectations: Uses a dotnet test --filter so that only this one test runs (the reported total is 1)
